task: SPEC-065/T009 attempt 1 follow-up: NC-10 counter, --self-check and the sandbox allow-list
decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive guided questions in the HAR orchestrator session, 2026-11-04, recorded verbatim. Additive to founder-decisions-20261103.json and -20261103b.json, which stay as written.

decisions.item: How the NC-10 session counter treats session 1 of attempt t009-20261104, refused by the backend before claude ran
decisions.question: NC-10: ¿cómo tratamos la sesión 1, que se rechazó sin llegar a ejecutar claude?

decision.reading: The refused session 1 is not counted against a new attempt: the next attempt is a new attempt name with its own output directory and the full budget of 3 sessions. The counter of the earlier directory is not edited.

decisions.question: ¿Aceptas que --self-check ejecute 'claude --version' dentro del sandbox (sin sesión, sin modelo y sin cuota)?

decision.reading: The self-check may run the pinned `claude --version` under the sandbox profile (the compile check's allowed run) and the F4 fixtures, with no session, no prompt, no model call and no usage. It never starts a session.

decisions.item: How much the sandbox profile opens so that claude can start (macOS 27.2)
decisions.question: ¿Cuánto abrimos el sandbox para que claude pueda arrancar?

decision.reading: Only a closed list of read-only system information seen in the kernel sandbox log: sysctl-read by exact name or the narrow prefix hw.optional., locale data reads under /usr/share/locale, and metadata-only reads of /etc and /var. Everything else stays denied: network, mach-lookup, /System/Volumes/Data, writes outside the allowed directories, and kern.bootargs unless shown necessary (then an open question for the founder). Implemented (locale narrowed to three literal LC_CTYPE files); self re-check in evidence/t009-selfcheck1-20261104.md and evidence/recheck-t009-sandbox-allowlist.md.

stillOpen: kern.bootargs for the claude process: stays denied; to be raised only if the next self-check still fails with the closed list allowed
mach-lookup (opendirectoryd.libinfo, notification_center): requested by python only; nothing added
the /usr/bin/curl exec attempt by claude --version: stays denied; read with the new compileExit integers
limits: Records three founder decisions only. executionAuthorization stays false and issuance stays T010 (NC-9, founder only). The earlier records are not rewritten. No native session, probe, sudo command or account change was run for this record. The profile edit needs the orchestrator's security re-check before the founder repeats the self-check.
